words.definition: vi. 爬行，蹑手蹑脚地走；（数量）不知不觉增长；n. 爬行

examples.en: He crept upstairs so as not to wake his parents.
examples.zh: 他蹑手蹑脚地上楼，以免吵醒父母。

examples.en: Old age creeps up on everyone before they realize it.
examples.zh: 岁月不饶人，人总在不知不觉中老去。

words.usage: 过去式、过去分词均为 crept，不规则变化须牢记。短语 creep in 悄悄出现：Doubts crept into her mind 疑虑暗生；creep up on sb 不知不觉降临或逼近。派生：creepy adj. 阴森吓人的；creep n. 讨厌鬼（俚语）。
collocations: creep up on sb 悄悄逼近
doubts creep in 疑虑暗生
prices creep up 物价悄悄上涨
words.mnemonic: creep 过去式 crept，同 keep→kept、sleep→slept 家族

words.definition: vt. 减去；扣除

examples.en: If you subtract twelve from twenty, you get eight.
examples.zh: 二十减十二得八。

examples.en: Tax and insurance are subtracted from the gross salary each month.
examples.zh: 税费和保险每月从工资总额中扣除。

words.usage: 数学与财务常用：subtract A from B 从 B 中减去 A，注意宾语方向。派生：subtraction n. 减法，与 addition 加法、multiplication 乘法、division 除法构成四则运算。近义 deduct 更正式，多指从总额中扣减：tax deducted from salary。
collocations: subtract A from B 从 B 中减去 A
subtract the cost 扣除成本
subtraction sign 减号
words.mnemonic: sub（向下）+tract（拉）→ 往下拉 → 减去，扣除

words.definition: v. 滴下，滴水；n. 水滴，滴水声；滴注

examples.en: The tap was dripping all night, keeping me awake.
examples.zh: 水龙头滴了一整夜，吵得我睡不着。

examples.en: His voice was dripping with irony as he praised the plan.
examples.zh: 他称赞这项计划时，话音里满是讥讽。

words.usage: 指液体断续下落：Water dripped from the tap all night。名词指水滴与滴水声。习语 be dripping with sth 洋溢着、充满：a voice dripping with sarcasm 满是讥讽的语气。医疗场景 intravenous drip 静脉滴注，口语说「打点滴」。
collocations: a dripping tap 滴水的龙头
drip with sarcasm 满是讥讽
intravenous drip 静脉输液
words.mnemonic: drip 连续滴，drop 单滴落；i 像水珠悬而未落

words.definition: n. 远征，探险；探险队，考察队；出行

examples.en: The team mounted an expedition to map the unexplored ocean trench.
examples.zh: 团队发起了一次探险，以测绘那片未勘探的海沟。

examples.en: The Arctic expedition ran short of food in its third month.
examples.zh: 北极探险队在第三个月出现了食物短缺。

words.usage: 指有组织、有目的的远途探险或考察：go on an expedition 去远征；scientific expedition 科学考察（队）。指人时即探险队：The expedition set off at dawn 探险队拂晓出发。派生：expeditionary adj. 远征的，如 expeditionary force 远征军。
collocations: go on an expedition 去远征探险
scientific expedition 科学考察
mountain expedition 登山探险队
words.mnemonic: ex（出）+ped（脚）+tion → 迈脚出行 → 远征探险

words.definition: v. 深为畏惧，非常担心；n. 恐惧，忧虑

examples.en: She dreaded the moment when she would have to speak in public.
examples.zh: 她深深畏惧着必须当众发言的那一刻。

examples.en: The thought of another lonely weekend filled him with dread.
examples.zh: 一想到又要独自过周末，他心里就充满恐惧。

words.usage: dread doing sth 害怕做某事，后接动名词；dread to think 不敢往下想。名词常搭 fill sb with dread 令某人充满恐惧、in dread of sth 惧怕某事。派生：dreadful adj. 可怕的、糟糕透的，口语中常表「很糟」；dreadfully adv. 非常，极其。
collocations: dread doing sth 害怕做某事
fill sb with dread 令人生惧
in dread of sth 惧怕某事
words.mnemonic: dread 里藏 read：一被点名朗读就畏惧

words.definition: n. 炸药；adj. 爆炸（性）的；急剧增长的；极易引发争论的

examples.en: The demand for data storage has been explosive in the AI era.
examples.zh: 人工智能时代，数据存储需求呈爆炸式增长。

examples.en: The police defused the explosive device hidden in the suitcase.
examples.zh: 警方拆除了藏在手提箱里的爆炸装置。

words.usage: 作形容词可修饰抽象名词：explosive growth 激增、an explosive issue 爆炸性议题。作可数名词指炸药：plant explosives 安放炸药。派生：explode v. 爆炸，爆发；explosion n. 爆炸；激增，如 population explosion 人口爆炸。
collocations: explosive growth 爆炸式增长
explosive device 爆炸装置
explosive issue 爆炸性议题
words.mnemonic: explode 去 de 加 sive → explosive 爆炸（性）的

words.definition: n. 旱灾，干旱（期）；长期缺乏

examples.en: Prolonged drought has driven up global food prices.
examples.zh: 持续干旱推高了全球粮食价格。

examples.en: The drought left the reservoirs at their lowest levels in decades.
examples.zh: 这场旱灾使水库蓄水量降至几十年来的最低点。

words.usage: gh 不发音，与 though、right 同类。搭配 severe or prolonged drought 严重、持续干旱；combat drought 抗旱。引申义长期匮乏：a drought of fresh ideas 新思想的枯竭。派生：drought-stricken adj. 遭受旱灾的，新闻报道高频。
collocations: severe drought 严重干旱
combat drought 抗旱
drought-stricken area 旱灾区
words.mnemonic: dry+out 合体成 drought：水都干了 → 旱灾

words.definition: v. 散步，漫步；n. 溜达，闲逛

examples.en: They strolled along the river bank, enjoying the evening breeze.
examples.zh: 他们沿着河岸漫步，享受着傍晚的微风。

examples.en: Grandpa takes a stroll in the park after dinner every day.
examples.zh: 爷爷每天晚饭后都去公园遛个弯。

words.usage: 指悠闲从容地散步：stroll along the river 沿河漫步；名词短语 take or go for a stroll 去遛弯。与 wander 相比，stroll 重闲适，wander 重漫无目的。派生：stroller n. 散步者；（美）婴儿推车，一词两义须看语境。
collocations: take a stroll 散个步
stroll along the beach 沿海滩漫步
a leisurely stroll 悠闲的漫步
words.mnemonic: st+roll（滚动）→ 慢慢滚着走 → 闲逛；scroll 才是滚屏

words.definition: n. 青肿，瘀伤；擦痕；v. 使淤青，碰伤；挫伤（感情）

examples.en: She fell off the bike and got a large bruise on her knee.
examples.zh: 她从自行车上摔下来，膝盖上淤青了一大块。

examples.en: The scandal bruised the firm's reputation but did not destroy it.
examples.zh: 丑闻挫伤了公司声誉，但并未将它击垮。

words.usage: 本义瘀伤（皮肤未破）：a bruise on one's knee 膝盖淤青；水果碰伤：The pears bruise easily 这梨不禁碰。引申挫伤感情、自尊：bruise sb's ego 挫伤自尊。派生：bruising adj. 艰苦耗人的：a bruising campaign 一场鏖战式竞选。
collocations: bruise one's ego 挫伤自尊
covered in bruises 遍布淤青
bruise easily 容易碰伤
words.mnemonic: 谐音 blues：撞出一块「蓝调色」的淤青

words.definition: adj. 听觉的，听力的；耳朵的

examples.en: The listening test measures students' aural comprehension.
examples.zh: 听力测试考查的是学生的听觉理解能力。

examples.en: For many deaf people, communication shifts from aural to visual channels.
examples.zh: 对许多听障人士而言，交流从听觉渠道转向视觉渠道。

words.usage: 只作形容词，指听觉的：aural skills 听力技能、aural comprehension 听觉理解。英音中与 oral（口头的）完全同音，听力考试须靠语境分辨，为经典考点。词根 aur 表「耳」，与 audio、audience 同族同源，可串联记忆。
collocations: aural skills 听力技能
aural comprehension 听觉理解
aural and oral training 听说训练
words.mnemonic: aur（耳）+al → 耳朵的；aural 与 oral 同音，一耳一口

words.definition: n. 条纹；军衔袖章；（某类）人

examples.en: A zebra's stripes are believed to confuse biting insects.
examples.zh: 人们认为斑马的条纹能迷惑叮咬它们的昆虫。

examples.en: Economists of every stripe warned against the risky policy.
examples.zh: 各派经济学家都警告不要推行这项冒险政策。

words.usage: 指与底色不同的长条纹：black and white stripes 黑白条纹；军服袖口的 stripes 指军衔条。习语 of all or every stripes 形形色色的：politicians of all stripes 各派政客，考研阅读出现过。派生：striped adj. 有条纹的：a striped shirt 条纹衬衫。
collocations: black and white stripes 黑白条纹
politicians of all stripes 各派政客
a striped shirt 条纹衬衫
words.mnemonic: strip 细条；多个 e 像花纹 → stripe 条纹

words.definition: n. 货物；货运；vt. 装运（货物）

examples.en: Rising freight costs are squeezing the profits of small exporters.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的运费正在挤压小出口商的利润。

examples.en: Most of the country's coal is moved by rail freight.
examples.zh: 该国大部分煤炭通过铁路货运运送。

words.usage: 物流经济高频：freight costs 运费、air and sea freight 空运与海运、freight train 货运列车。与 goods 泛指货物不同，freight 强调「运输途中」的货物。派生：freighter n. 货船、运输机；freight forwarder 货运代理，行业术语。
collocations: freight costs 运费
air freight 空运货物
freight train 货运列车
words.mnemonic: freight 里藏 eight：八车皮的货 → 货运

words.definition: vi. 努力，奋斗；力求，力争

examples.en: The company constantly strives to improve the quality of its products.
examples.zh: 公司不断努力提升产品质量。

examples.en: Scientists strive for a deeper understanding of the universe.
examples.zh: 科学家们力求更深入地理解宇宙。

words.usage: 正式用语，过去式 strove，过去分词 striven，变化不规则。strive to do sth 力求做某事；strive for sth 为…而奋斗。考研阅读常见 strive to remain competitive 力争保持竞争力。派生：striving n. 奋斗，努力，亦常作形容词。
collocations: strive for perfection 追求完美
strive to do sth 力求做某事
strive against hardships 与苦难抗争
words.mnemonic: strive→strove→striven，同 drive→drove→driven 不规则变化

words.definition: n. 冲突，纷争；争斗

examples.en: The region has endured decades of ethnic strife.
examples.zh: 该地区饱受数十年种族冲突之苦。

examples.en: The empire was torn apart by internal strife and foreign invasions.
examples.zh: 这个帝国被内乱与外族入侵撕扯得四分五裂。

words.usage: 书面正式，不可数名词，多指群体间持续冲突：internal strife 内乱、ethnic strife 种族纷争、industrial strife 劳资纠纷（英式）。常见搭配 be torn apart by strife 被纷争撕裂。较 conflict 更强调长期骚乱与不和。
collocations: internal strife 内部纷争
ethnic strife 种族冲突
be torn apart by strife 因纷争而分裂
words.mnemonic: strive 去掉 v（胜利）：没了胜利就剩纷争 strife

words.definition: vt. 拥抱；紧抱；（道路等）紧贴，环抱；n. 拥抱

examples.en: She hugged her son tightly before he boarded the train.
examples.zh: 儿子上火车前，她紧紧地拥抱了他。

examples.en: The coastal road hugs the cliff for the next ten miles.
examples.zh: 接下来十英里，滨海公路一直紧贴着悬崖。

words.usage: 基本义拥抱：give sb a big hug 给个大大的拥抱、bear hug 熊抱。引申义紧贴、环绕：The road hugs the coast 公路紧贴海岸。习语 hug oneself over sth 暗自得意。派生：huggable adj. 令人想拥抱的、可爱的；口语 hug it out 抱一抱和解。

synonyms.note: 拥抱，正式；亦指欣然接受

collocations: give sb a big hug 给某人一个大大的拥抱
a tight hug 紧紧的拥抱
hug the coastline 紧贴海岸线
words.mnemonic: u 像张开的双臂，h 像弯腰俯身 → hug 拥抱

words.definition: n. 中风；一击，一笔；妙举；v. 抚摸

examples.en: His grandfather suffered a stroke and lost the ability to speak.
examples.zh: 他祖父中风后丧失了说话能力。

examples.en: The new policy changed the industry at one stroke.
examples.zh: 新政策一举改变了整个行业。

words.usage: 一词多义考点密集：have or suffer a stroke 患中风；at one stroke 一举；a brush stroke 一笔；stroke the dog 抚摸小狗。游泳四式多含之：breaststroke 蛙泳、butterfly stroke 蝶泳、backstroke 仰泳，联想记忆效果好。
collocations: suffer a stroke 患中风
at one stroke 一举
stroke a cat 抚摸小猫
words.mnemonic: o 像划出的圆弧：stroke 一划、一笔、一抚；strike 才是击

words.definition: n. 摩擦（力）；矛盾，冲突

examples.en: Friction between the moving parts generates considerable heat.
examples.zh: 运动部件之间的摩擦会产生大量热量。

examples.en: Currency disputes added new friction to the trade talks.
examples.zh: 货币争端给贸易谈判增添了新的摩擦。

words.usage: 物理义摩擦力：Friction generates heat 摩擦生热；引申人际、国家间的摩擦与矛盾：cause friction between the two sides 引起双方摩擦。派生：frictional adj. 摩擦的；frictionless adj. 无摩擦的，常作引申「顺畅无阻的」，如 frictionless trade 顺畅贸易。
collocations: cause friction 引起摩擦
reduce friction 减少摩擦
trade friction 贸易摩擦
words.mnemonic: fric（摩擦）+tion；fiction 小说、fraction 分数三胞胎

words.definition: n. 审计，查账；vt. 审计；旁听（课程）

examples.en: The company's accounts are audited by an independent firm each year.
examples.zh: 公司账目每年由独立事务所审计。

examples.en: The annual audit revealed serious flaws in the financial controls.
examples.zh: 年度审计暴露出财务控制方面的严重漏洞。

words.usage: 财经核心词：conduct an audit 开展审计、internal and external audit 内外部审计、tax audit 税务稽查。美式校园义 audit a course 旁听课程不计学分。派生：auditor n. 审计员；auditory adj. 听觉的，词根 audi「听」一线贯穿。
collocations: conduct an audit 开展审计
internal audit 内部审计
audit the accounts 查账
words.mnemonic: audi（听）+t → 听账目汇报 → 审计；同根 audience

words.definition: v. （使）淹死；淹没；盖过（声音）

examples.en: The floods drowned entire villages within hours.
examples.zh: 洪水在几小时内淹没了整座整座的村庄。

examples.en: He turned up the music to drown out the noise next door.
examples.zh: 他把音乐调大，好盖过隔壁的噪音。

words.usage: 及物、不及物均可：He drowned 他淹死了；The flood drowned the village 洪水淹没村庄。短语 drown out（声音）盖过：The applause drowned out her speech。习语 drown one's sorrows 借酒浇愁；like a drowned rat 像落汤鸡一样。
collocations: drown out the noise 盖过噪音
drown one's sorrows 借酒浇愁
be drowned in work 埋头于工作
words.mnemonic: d(rown) 里藏 row 划船：船翻了 → 淹没

words.definition: n. 拍卖（会）；vt. 拍卖

examples.en: The rare manuscript will be auctioned in London next month.
examples.zh: 这份珍稀手稿将于下月在伦敦拍卖。

examples.en: The painting fetched two million dollars at auction.
examples.zh: 这幅画在拍卖会上拍出了两百万美元。

words.usage: at auction 在拍卖中；auction sth off 把…拍卖掉；auction house 拍卖行。经济学常以拍卖说明价格机制：拍卖价由竞价决定。派生：auctioneer n. 拍卖师，亦作动词主持拍卖；Dutch auction 荷兰式拍卖，即降价拍卖。
collocations: sell sth at auction 拍卖某物
auction house 拍卖行
auction off 拍卖掉
words.mnemonic: auc=aug（增）+tion → 价钱一路抬 → 拍卖
